topic.title: Terminology Checker Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Terminology Checker add-on checks terminology by highlighting matched terms based on custom rules.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: offers an add-on that provides support for checking terminology. Once the add-on is installed, you can create a terminology file with a set of rules for each term (or sequence of characters) you want flagged. After referencing the custom file, will automatically highlight matched terms in the Author visual editing mode and offer some contextual menu actions.The terminology checker works for any document opened in the Author visual editing mode, including XML file types, and JSON and HTML5 document types.
